principles.title: Events are the only source of truth
principles.summary: The event log is the single durable artefact of the bank. Nothing else is authoritative.

principles.title: Every action traces to a source
principles.summary: No procedure, control, validation, posting, screening rule, report line, contract clause, payroll deduction, or tax computation may exist without a structured citation to the regulation, standard, contract, or internal policy that justifies it.

principles.title: Cloud-native; nothing manual or physical except where essential
principles.summary: The bank operates in the cloud and conducts every process digitally. Manual or physical steps are exceptions that must be justified.

principles.title: Security designed in from the start
principles.summary: Security is a foundational design constraint, not a layer added later.

principles.title: Multi-currency, multi-entity, multi-country from day one
principles.summary: Single-currency, single-entity, single-jurisdiction shortcuts are forbidden, even when only one of each exists at the start.

principles.title: Single-graph discipline: presentations derive downward, capabilities justify upward
principles.summary: > *Consolidates the former Principles 6 (presentations derive from data) and 7 (implementation traceability), approved on 2026-05-06. Principle 2 (atomic citation discipline) remains separate; this principle is the structural rule about how those citations connect into a single graph.*

principles.title: Autonomous by default; humans oversee the residual
principles.summary: The bank is an autonomous AI-run institution. Every persona — engineering and governance — is a standing autonomous agent that runs on its own cadence and discharges its mandate. Human involvement (Marc as CEO; future human overseers) is reserved for the residual set of decisions and actions that an agent cannot make on its own.

ZAR settlement — bank is not a SAMOS clearing participant
decisionsResolved.outcome: Approved. The bank does not become a direct SAMOS settlement participant. ZAR clearing flows via a SAMOS-sponsor bank (indirect participant model). Same operating posture as the FX correspondent decision (D-FX-CLS-MEMBERSHIP corrected): capital-light, ops-light, sponsor-routed access to critical market-infrastructures. Touches the licence-type question — Mira + Imani + Saskia must confirm whether the intended licence supports indirect SAMOS participation, or whether the licence type itself shifts away from a full SARB Section 16 banking licence toward a specialised / wholesale arrangement that does not require direct SAMOS membership. Devon owns the third-party-risk governance for the SAMOS sponsor; Tomas owns the operational connectivity; Eitan re-scopes intraday liquidity / HQLA management to operate without a direct SARB account.

decisionsResolved.title: FX settlement path — correspondent routing (corrects earlier bilateral-settlement record)
decisionsResolved.outcome: Approved (correction). The bank does not join CLS directly (neither Settlement Member nor Third-Party-Customer). FX settles via correspondent routing — a CLS-member correspondent bank handles the actual settlement; the bank instructs via SWIFT MT202 / pacs.009. Earlier same-day record of this decision read No as bilateral settlement; that interpretation is corrected. Herstatt risk is concentrated on the correspondent (highly-rated, intraday-only) rather than every FX counterparty bilaterally; outsourcing & third-party-risk treatment applies (PA Directive 3 of 2018 on outsourcing of material functions). Devon owns the third-party-risk surface; Imani contracts the correspondent agreement; Senna conducts cyber due diligence; Mira covers sanctions / FIC dimension on the correspondent.
decisionsResolved.comment: Correction issued same day as the original record. The original event remains in the log for audit; the projection latest-wins logic in derive.ts shows this corrected outcome on the dashboard.

decisionsResolved.title: FX markets-vs-treasury book boundary — explicit tag at execution
decisionsResolved.outcome: Approved as recommended. bookType discriminator on the Identification primitive set at TradeExecuted time; reclassification only via explicit TradeAmended event with audit trail. No post-hoc reclassification. Saskia + Eitan own jointly; Helena governs the framework; Bea applies IFRS dispatch.

decisionsResolved.title: FX Authorised-Dealer status — full SARB Authorised Dealer
decisionsResolved.outcome: Approved. The bank pursues full SARB Authorised-Dealer status, not ADLA and not correspondent-routing. Decision touches the licence application; Saskia + Mira + Imani own the AD application track.
